name: Steeple-bush
desc: Steeple-bush (Spiraea douglasii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 25 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Spiraea douglasii is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. Common names include hardhack, hardhack steeplebush, Douglas' spirea, douglasspirea, steeplebush, and rose spirea.
